title: Farm gate
description: A white five-bar double farm gate (two leaves with a diagonal brace each) between two chunky wooden posts with white caps, 7 m across, closing a gap in a fence. Nodes leaf_L (pivot at its +x post) and leaf_R (pivot at its -x post) swing about Y to open.
checks: FRONT tile: two white five-bar leaves meeting in the middle between two brown posts, a diagonal brace on each
TOP tile: a thin straight line along X with the posts at the ends
